capability.title: Ordering Channels
capability.description: Display-only ordering guide that lists the pickup, delivery, and catering channels with an icon, a description, an optional link, and a closing note.
useWhen: A page should explain how guests can order without taking the order itself
Pickup, delivery, and catering options need a short side-by-side comparison
avoidWhen: The page must capture, submit, or pay for an order
One ordering channel needs only a single sentence of context
